items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: And Pete Boccage, he's a good Anilton player.

ctx.x: Were there any good Anilton players there?

Well yeah, they had Joe Payan, he was a good Anilton player. And Pete Boccage, he's a good Anilton player. And my daddy, he's a pretty good Anilton player. And that's about all I can think of, presents.
What about tuba? They have any good tuba players?
